🤖 AI Assistant — limits & models

Available to all signed-in users when enabled. Set separate daily AI request limits and control whether regular users can choose models. The Worker enforces these settings. Admins keep access when AI is globally disabled.

Enable AI for everyone
When OFF, only real admins can use AI. Otherwise, any signed-in account gets the regular daily allowance.
Daily AI questions · regular users
Defaults to 10 per UTC day per signed-in user. Existing usage does not reset when you change the number.
Daily AI questions · admins
Separate limit for owner and verified Admin Hub accounts; defaults to 600 per UTC day.
Let regular users change AI models
OFF hides the model dropdown and forces Instant for ordinary text requests. Images use Vision automatically. Admins can always choose a model.

YouTube / Google setup
Search needs a YouTube Data API v3 key. Linking a Google account also needs a Google OAuth Web Client ID with your site added as an Authorized JavaScript origin.
Google does not expose the exact private YouTube Home/Shorts recommendation algorithm through the public API. When linked on any one device, this app saves only a small recommendation profile (channel IDs, liked-video metadata, and videos watched in this app) to your chat account so your other devices can use the same feed without signing into Google. OAuth access tokens and Google passwords are never stored in Firebase. The referrer-restricted YouTube API key and public OAuth Client ID sync with your chat account and are loaded only for the currently signed-in chat account on each device, so switching accounts does not inherit another account’s key. Repeated identical searches are cached for 12 hours, and the Shorts feed avoids the expensive YouTube search endpoint when possible.
🔑 Share your key
Generate a one-time code and choose how long it stays valid. Whoever enters it below gets view-only access to your key (not your Google account or watch history). Each code only works once, and you can revoke access any time.
🔓 Redeem a shared code
Codes can only be redeemed once. Their expiration is chosen by the person who generates the code.

Press a key anywhere in the app to jump to a URL. Click “Set key”, tap any key, then enter the link.

Reset your LiveChat password

Enter the recovery email connected to your LiveChat account. Check Inbox and Spam/Junk for the reset link.

Username-only accounts without a connected recovery email cannot reset their password here. For help, email codingboy.ca@gmail.com. If you sign in with Google, use Google sign-in; for a forgotten Google password, use Google Account recovery with your Gmail or Google account email.
